title: Conditions of Sale for Air Ticket Fare Brands: Booking and Ticketing
content:
**1. Sale of a fare brand.** A fare brand under Air Ticket Fare Brands may only be sold where all three of the following hold of the booking: it is opened at least the brand's advance-purchase distance ahead of the outbound departure date; the return falls no earlier than the brand's minimum stay and no later than its maximum stay; and the number of travellers is below the brand's group threshold.

**1.1 The edge of each limb.** A booking opened exactly the brand's advance-purchase distance ahead of the outbound departure date is at that distance and satisfies the first limb, while a booking opened nearer to departure than that distance does not. A return falling exactly at the brand's minimum stay is no earlier than it and satisfies, while a return one night short of it does not. A return falling exactly at the brand's maximum stay is no later than it and satisfies, while a return one day beyond it does not. A party one traveller fewer than the brand's group threshold is below the threshold and satisfies, while a party of exactly the threshold is not below it and does not.

**2. Unticketed holds.** An unticketed hold stands for the brand's hold window and is released without charge when it lapses. A brand whose hold window is zero must be ticketed in the same session or not sold at all.

**3. Collection at ticketing.** Ticketing collects the fare, the taxes and carrier fees, and the agency service fee together. A partly collected booking is never ticketed.

**4. Instalments.** Where the traveller qualifies for an instalment plan under the brand held and the booking value reaches the brand's instalment threshold, the fare may be collected in instalments, and the ticket is issued on the first instalment. Both limbs are required together: a qualifying traveller whose booking value has not reached the brand's instalment threshold, and a booking of ample value held under a brand that offers no instalment plan, are alike outside this condition.

**5. Groups.** A group of travellers at or above the brand's group threshold is not ticketed under this charter at all, and is passed to the group desk.
